prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a FIVE-FRAME SPRITE SHEET for this exact Song dynasty elderly man: one standing pose plus one complete four-frame walk cycle, all walking toward the RIGHT of the image in the same three-quarter side view as the reference. Keep his identity: small black cap, thin grey beard, slightly stooped back, long brown outer robe with dark trim over a dark inner robe, grey trousers, dark cloth shoes, the SAME tall wooden walking stick held in his right hand. He is old: SHORT careful steps, the stick is planted on the ground ahead together with the forward foot and carried forward during each passing frame. The head stays at the same height and the same horizontal position in every walking cell; the body only bobs very slightly. Cell 1 = standing at rest, feet together, facing right. Cell 2 = contact: right leg forward with heel touching the ground, left leg back on its toes, longest stride. Cell 3 = passing: weight on the right leg straight under the body, left leg bent and passing forward beside it, foot just off the ground. Cell 4 = contact: left leg forward with heel touching the ground, right leg back on its toes, longest stride, mirror of cell 2. Cell 5 = passing: weight on the left leg straight under the body, right leg bent and passing forward, foot just off the ground. Correct leg anatomy, the robe hem swings with the legs, no extra limbs. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 5 equal-width cells, one full figure per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so tools, cloth, grain and hands never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Redraw at higher detail than the small reference without changing the design. Make every cell match the reference figure and match each other as strictly as possible.
